name: GrantPortfolioTracker
tagline: Every grant bid and award in one Power Apps component – deadlines, decisions, drawdown vs spend, funder reports and renewals.
description: A complete grant portfolio app for nonprofits: a funder pipeline from Prospect to LOI, Application and Award with stage gates; submission deadlines and expected decisions; restricted awards with drawdown and spend tracked against the time elapsed; deliverables; interim and final funder reports with cover notes; close-out checks; and a weighted renewal forecast. Works in canvas and model-driven apps and on Power Pages.
features: Prospect → LOI → Application → Awarded → Reporting → Closed with stage gates
Submission deadlines, late-submission check and expected decisions
Drawdown vs spend vs time elapsed with underspend, overspend, claim and cash-held alerts
Interim and final funder reports with cover note
Report extensions agreed with the funder
Renewal likelihood, weighted forecast and one-click renewal bid
